title: Consume the OPFS read slot directly in synchronous hosted WASI reads
question: Does avoiding the additional JavaScript spill copy reduce complete external Uniform Run time?
summary: Verified paired median savings of 0.345 seconds for 800,000 rows and 1.573 seconds for 3.2 million rows. All six measured pairs improved with matching spill topology and bridge traffic.

workloads: Standalone external Uniform, 800,000 and 3.2 million plain CSV rows, explicit 512 MiB, one worker and 4 MiB serialized output cap.

validation.summary: All eight jobs per cell verified fields, conservation, file hashes, exact cap and manifest, marker and workspace retirement. Focused pinned-shim controls cover multiple iovecs, positioned/short reads, EOF, thrown reads and owned export buffers.

limitations: One WSL Linux host, bundled Chromium, disposable OPFS contexts with uncontrolled warm OS caches.
exclusions: Renderer RSS, physical I/O, native execution and other browser channels.
